randomSampler.seed32: parse first 8 hexadecimal characters of sha256 digest as unsigned 32-bit integer
randomSampler.withoutReplacementAlgorithm: Create [1..49]. For i=0..5 choose j=i+floor(rng()*(49-i)), swap a[i] with a[j], then use a[i]. Sort the six selected values only for persistence/debug; order does not affect hits.
randomSampler.trajectory: For each slot and replicate, sum hits across the same first 200 settled target dates. Each target date receives its own deterministic seed material.

randomNullPValue.direction: one-sided; higher mean hits is better
randomNullPValue.randomMean: mean of the 10000 null total-hit trajectories divided by 200

holmBonferroni.procedure: Sort raw p ascending. At ordered position i=0..11 compute scaled=min(1,p*(12-i)); adjusted at i=max(previous adjusted,scaled). Map adjusted values back to original slots.

descriptiveBaselines.marginalFrequency: For each slot, mean hits of the corresponding frozen per-window marginal-frequency line across the same 200 dates.
descriptiveBaselines.recencyRecent: Mean hits of the frozen recent-recency line across the same 200 dates.
descriptiveBaselines.recencyOverdue: Mean hits of the frozen overdue-recency line across the same 200 dates.

candidatePass: observedMean > randomMean AND HolmAdjustedP < 0.05 AND observedMean > marginalFrequencyMean AND observedMean > recencyRecentMean AND observedMean > recencyOverdueMean
familyPass: at least one of the 12 frozen slots passes candidatePass with intact custody
promotionPolicy: A family pass is only a prospective cross-game transfer signal. It requires a new untouched preregistered replication before any stronger claim and never directly authorizes money.
